case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your cost situation. We fully understand that wage increases in the metal industry weigh on a foundry, and we value the quality your team delivers for our PH-100 housings.

At the same time, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have put together three options that each offer a longer contract term and therefore more planning security for your foundry. One of them also keeps your current payment terms unchanged:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

We look forward to hearing which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your understanding of our cost situation and the offer of a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for our foundry. 

For generations, our family business has stood for unwavering quality in this region, and our long partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH means a great deal to us. Building on your third option with our standard 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to adjust our price to €51.30 per unit. This step reflects the benefit of the longer commitment while ensuring the continued quality and reliability you expect from our team.

Under our proposal, our Angebot offers a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We appreciate your revised offer and your continued commitment to our long-standing partnership. Our family foundry has always valued the trust between our companies over many years. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

In response to your movement on the third option, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.70 per unit. This represents a fair balance that allows us to maintain the high quality standards you expect from our foundry.

We trust this accommodates your needs while honoring our shared history, and we look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
